name: Sussex County YMCA Day Camp
operator_name: Sussex County YMCA (Metropolitan YMCA of the Oranges)
street_address: Sussex County YMCA, 15 Wits End Rd.
description_short: YMCA day camp at the Sussex County YMCA in Hardyston with Junior Y camp for ages 3 to 4, Kids Y camp for ages 5 to 11, and a sports day camp for ages 8 to 13. Full days include daily swim lessons and an afternoon free swim; half days end at noon.

fees.name: Before camp care
fees.note: Community rate; Y members $35. 7 to 8 a.m.

fees.name: After camp care
fees.note: Community rate; Y members $60. 4 to 6 p.m., full day camp only.

refund_policy_summary: Full refund, deposit included, for cancellations by April 1, 2027; from April 2 all payments are forfeited and there are no credits for absence or illness. From February 1 changes through the Welcome Center cost $35 per child per request.
notes: Prices are community (non-member) rates: full day $416 a week ($395 early bird), half day $240 ($228 early bird). Y members pay $378 full day ($359 early bird) and $218 half day; Y family members $340.20 and $196. A 15% down payment is due at registration and counts toward the fee. Full day 8 a.m. to 4 p.m., half day 8 a.m. to noon. Campers bring a packed lunch. The day camp page also lists a theme for August 23 to 27, after the stated last day of August 20; sessions here follow the stated dates. Sports Day Camp (ages 8 to 13) has the same hours, dates and prices.
